messages:
Aisha (acct exec): FYI — WillowCare legal sent over a security questionnaire + POC checklist. They require IdP-initiated SAML, SCIM push (delta support), RBAC per-tenant roles, and domain ownership proofing. Can we confirm our supported flows and any pricing delta for Dedicated?
Marco (solutions): We support both SP and IdP-initiated SAML. SCIM 2.0 is supported; for delta we recommend PATCH with ETag. RBAC can be driven by group claims or a mapped `role` claim. Need to clarify customer expectations for provisioning latency and user churn.
Oliver (eng): Confirming: IdP-initiated SAML is supported. On Dedicated we can enable SCIM push webhook ingestion; default throttling is conservative (200 req/min) but can be raised for POC. For delta model best practice is PATCH + ifMatch using ETag.
Jenny (security): WillowCare also asked about key management — they want customer-managed KMS/HSM for signing keys and long-term audit retention (7 years). We have KMS integrations for Private; Dedicated requires contract addendum for HSM in some regions.
Aisha (acct exec): Good — they also want proof-of-domain checks (TXT + file), and to enforce tenant-level domain locking so users from other domains can't sign up. Any blockers?
Marco (solutions): We have domain verification via DNS TXT and HTML file upload. Tenant-level domain locking is supported via console setting (requires admin role). For provisioning mapping, here's a simple SCIM mapping snippet we can show them:
```
{"externalId":"{{idp.userId}}","userName":"{{email}}","active":true,"groups":["{{idp.groups}}"]}
```
Keep it illustrative, not literal.
Oliver (eng): One technical caveat: if they expect near-real-time user sync for +100k users, we'll want to discuss batch windows and rate uplift on Dedicated. Also session length/SAML assertion expiry — recommend 1h default, customer can request shorter.
Jenny (security): Also flag: audit trails for admin role assignments and SCIM events — WillowCare asked for event-level logs. We can export logs to their SIEM via syslog/CloudWatch depending on deployment. For Dedicated, retention is configurable but long retention may be an add-on.
Aisha (acct exec): Pricing ask: they want to know if SCIM/RBAC adds a line item or if this is all included in Dedicated pricing. Quick answer for the call?
Marco (solutions): Short answer: base Dedicated includes SSO and basic SCIM. High-volume SCIM ingestion, HSM/KMS, and extended audit retention are priced as add-ons. Integration support (mapping, custom attribute work) is typically 1-2 engineer-days for a standard POC.
Oliver (eng): For the POC env we can provision a committed Dedicated sandbox in `dedicated-nyc-01` — Deploy-bot is spinning it up now. We can mirror their IdP in staging for tests.
Deploy-bot: New POC environment provisioned: dedicated-nyc-01 (id: poc-171999).
Marco (solutions): Next steps: 1) share SCIM mapping guide + SAML SP metadata; 2) estimate add-on costs for HSM and extended logs; 3) schedule 45m SSO+provisioning runbook with WillowCare (we should include an SRE/eng rep). Who can join tomorrow 10am PT?
Aisha (acct exec): I'll book 10am PT. Marco, please drop the sample metadata and a short one-pager on add-on pricing to the thread. Jenny — can you confirm compliance notes for the contract (audit retention + KMS) by EOD?
Jenny (security): Will do. Also I'll attach the SOC2/ISO answers we usually send for Dedicated deals.
Oliver (eng): I'll prep a quick note on rate limits and recommended batch strategy for >10k users.
Marco (solutions): Copy. Will post the SAML SP XML + SCIM sample link here: https://console.redwood.ai/docs/scim (share in meeting).
Aisha (acct exec): Thanks team — want this to be low friction for WillowCare. If we need to surface any engineering time to QBR, flag it here. :thumbsup:
